text:
anya: heads-up — p95 jumped on eu endpoint-A in the latency dashboard but p99 barely moved. short blip ~4m, anybody on it?
jared: yup saw it. slice: /v1/generate -> eu -> endpoint-A. curious that p50 also nudged a bit but tail stayed.
marta: small-sample volatility or merge-weighting. our rollout buckets sample differently which biases mid-quantiles.
liam: another common cause: panel using rollup-derived percentiles while the tooltip shows raw-window values. aggregation_mode mismatch.
anya: console panel config shows `use_raw_samples=false` and `aggregation_mode=rollup`. wonder if telemetry config flipped recently.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot applied telemetry-config v3.1 to prod-preview at 1759999600 (preserve_sample_counts=false)
jared: quick numbers: window 1759999460-1759999580 -> p50=105ms, p95=490ms, p99=1680ms, sample_count=195. prior window sample_count=410.
marta: histogram I pulled shows mass shifting from 80-140ms into 220-480ms; tail >1s unchanged. prefix-cache hitrate fell from 90%->72% in that period.
liam: routing also had a tiny fallback bump earlier. snippet:
```
route: generate
weights: {primary: 0.78, fallback-slow: 0.22}
```
if fallback weight increased transiently that would explain midtail lift.
anya: actionable: can we add a small "diagnostic quicklink" in the console that opens a pre-filled histogram + route-weight query for the selected window? would speed triage.
jared: +1. also propose showing sample_count delta and aggregation_mode inline next to p50/p95/p99 (e.g. "samples:195 (-52%) | mode:rollup"). prevents noisy alerts.
marta: agree. I'll file a tiny UX ticket for the badge + quicklink and attach the histogram query.
liam: I'll draft the PR for the console change and include a tooltip that surfaces last telemetry-config and whether raw samples were used.
anya: great — thanks. for now i'm muting the p95 alert for endpoint-A for 15m while we validate. :white_check_mark:
